item.title: Australia's AgriGen to establish Brunei's first private food laboratory
item.description: AgriGen and FarmFresh to establish the Brunei Integrated Analytical Laboratory (BIAL), offering precision food testing for industry.

item.title: Brunei launches Southeast Asia’s first net-zero, solar-powered shrimp farm
item.description: FDI-backed Jets expands supply chain to boost Brunei blue shrimp production at new Serasa site, targeting commercial harvest by year's end.

item.title: EnQuest secures Brunei’s offshore Block C, targets first gas by 2029
item.description: Brunei awards first production sharing agreement in over a decade to EnQuest, under Petroleum Authority’s upstream rejuvenation strategy.

item.title: Brunei's biggest solar plant targets launch by end of 2026
item.description: 30 MW solar plant on remediated landfill in Kg Belimbing, developed by Malaysia's Solarvest, Serikandi and Brunei government’s Khazanah Satu.

item.title: Brunei Week showcases growing presence of Brunei businesses in Singapore
item.description: BEDB launches Brunei Week in Singapore with 20 brands, highlighting retail channels through Mustafa, Aliyah Rizq and Flavours of Brunei.

item.title: Thailand’s Enserv to launch Brunei’s first sorghum cultivation and processing project
item.description: Enserv will launch Brunei’s first sorghum project at the Bio Innovation Corridor and KKP Tungku, producing grains and biofuels by year’s end.

item.title: CAEXPO positions Guangxi as gateway for Brunei businesses into China
item.description: Brunei businesses leverage Guangxi’s proximity at CAEXPO, the Sultanate’s closest gateway to China, to expand exports, trade and investment.

item.title: PDS and Singapore’s Aliyah Rizq partner to pioneer cattle breeding in Brunei
item.description: The partnership aims to build out Brunei’s livestock value chain – from breeding to slaughter and processing for domestic and export markets.

item.title: Procure.bn to connect suppliers with Darussalam Assets' business opportunities
item.description: Procure.bn by Darussalam Assets connects suppliers to its group’s business opportunities through a centralised digital procurement platform.

item.title: Wasan Milling Company more than doubles national milling capacity
item.description: His Majesty launches Wasan Milling Company’s upgraded facility as Brunei targets 20 percent rice self-sufficiency by 2027.
